benefit: Onion plantings between strawberry rows or at row ends discourage strawberry aphid (Chaetosiphon fragaefolii) and reduce strawberry mottle virus transmission. Strong fit in small-acreage matted-row systems.

members.title: Onion sets between strawberry rows
members.body: Set onions every 12 inches between strawberry rows at strawberry planting time. Pull onions before they bolt to limit competition.
